design: Purposive diagnostic case selection after E13. The protocol and municipality set precede map extraction. This is not a national probability sample or a blinded source transfer.
selection: Within E13 2021 previous-stock quartiles retain reference mapped area from 10000 to 250000 ha. Sort each remaining quartile by E12 level1 gross percentage then identifier, split into three equal-count severity groups, select the middle record in each. These are diagnostic cases, not a claim of population representativeness.
asset_choice: Enumerate cover folders. Require unique integration/coverage image with classification bands for both years. Save chosen exact IDs and metadata before summaries. Stop on ambiguity rather than silently use the first image.
grids: Primary uses projection and affine transform of collection7.1 classification band. Sensitivity uses collection10 native grid if different. No bestEffort coarsening. Default nearest-neighbour sampling for categorical bands.
support: Same municipality geometry and soil collection3 band for both classifications. Soil>=0 and both coverage masks define common support. Keep class0 separate. Sum stock per pixel as soil tC/ha times pixelArea ha, with identical region weights for both cover versions.
summaries: Pixel area and stock by original code pair
Parent group transition matrix under E12 level1 mapping
Net and gross group stock differences on common support
Mask membership area and stock for both, only71, only10, neither
Comparison with E12 municipal gross and source extraction estimates
checks: Pair matrix margins reconcile with parent totals
Common-support total stock equal for both classifications by construction
Gross group difference no greater than twice stock attached to between-parent transitions
Returned identifiers and years match fixed sample
limits: A map label transition is not environmental change
No unique attribution between classification algorithm, input imagery and revised class definitions
Purposive sample cannot estimate national transition prevalence
E12 uses class mean times area while E14 uses pixel stock sums and explicitly matched grid, so differences require reconciliation rather than being declared source errors
execution: Read public Earth Engine assets with user authorization. Download summary JSON only. Do not publish assets, create storage buckets or include credentials in the supplement.
